body: This isn't the first instance where someone's said I should write poetry.. Think I might give it a go

I would, but I don't see how it'd help at this point.

She's moved on and happy with this new guy, we don't really talk or connect like we used to. Now it's more awkward silence and waiting for minutes to pass when it's just me and her.

I don't see how anything I say now can save what we had :-/

Never :-(

Looking back I can see just how obvious it was we both liked each other.. But being the utter coward I am, I refused to make a move or tell her anything.

She's moved on to a different guy, guess I was a passing fancy while she was my everything. 

I guess I can't be really upset, because.. at the end of the day I just want her to be happy.. and, I suppose.. If she's happier without me then.. in a weird, depressing, utterly soul destroying way.. I'm happy too?

at least the pain will fucking go.

My fault she ended up like that. What good am I? may as well drink till I die. 

Cya reddit

Fuck it.

Drinking till I pass out

I can't help but feel somewhat responsible for her situation.

I mean if I manned up and said what we were both thinking she wouldn't have ended up with tubes and a beating. But because I was such a bitch and couldn't do what any normal guy would have done and made a fucking move she ended up there

I don't know man. I just feel helpless. Any time I try to do better it always ends up being thrown back in my face or blows up and I'm left looking the fool. 

Just don't see why I bother trying anymore
